title: Al-'iffah wa al-isti'dad li al-zawaj: hiwar sarīḥ bilā khajal
summary: At this age, the instinct intensifies and temptations multiply, and your silence does not protect him—it leaves him prey to distorted sources. Speak to him with dignity and frankness about 'iffah (chastity), the boundaries of relationships, and the value of marriage as a source of tranquility and protection. Help him control himself through fasting, exercise, and beneficial engagement. Your haya (modesty) about the conversation will push him toward worse sources.
try_this: This week: Initiate a calm conversation (not a lecture) about a question related to relationships or marriage. Listen to his opinion first before guiding him, and let him know your door is always open for any question.
reflection_prompts: Does your son feel he can ask you frankly about these matters?
What practical value did you reinforce with him this week?
warning_flags: علاقة محرّمة قائمة أو سلوك خطر

review_defects.arabic: العفّة والاستعداد للزواج: حوارٌ صريحٌ بلا خجل
review_defects.english: Al-'iffah wa al-isti'dad li al-zawaj: hiwar sarih bila khajal
review_defects.why: The title is transliterated instead of translated. An English reader who does not know Arabic will not understand the meaning. The Arabic means 'Chastity and Preparation for Marriage: A Frank Conversation Without Shame'.
